mission: Finish and empirically prove one persistent portable multi-use mini entity: executable contains only the generic processing pipeline; Zero blog is fully editable SQLite application configuration.

hard_split.binary: evidence -> generic preprocessor -> canonical envelope -> configured API -> generic gates -> exactly-once/CAS -> atomic SQLite persistence
hard_split.database: profile/personality/system prompt/application blob/provider settings and default zero_blog preset
hard_split.regression: never hard-code replaceable Zero/blog/personality semantics into the executable

truth_law: UNKNOWN != ZERO != ERROR != MEASURED; model narrative is never canonical state authority

provider_law.architecture_guard: immutable generic pipeline law above editable application
provider_law.secret_rule: never expose, print or commit token values

go: Maximal swarm cycle on this one neutral pipeline + configurable DB only: refresh, fan-out, hypotheses, counterhypotheses, implement, sandbox-test, falsify, fuse/hypofuse, fix, retest, persist.
swarm_product_rule: swarm is research/build orchestration only; product runtime is exactly one entity
legacy_scope: All previous ClayVerse/EntityOS/Frank/UCM/GWT/ClayCode work is donor evidence only unless it advances this mini entity.
